name: Originality.ai
tagline: Originality.ai detects AI-generated content from GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and other models with high accuracy. It is designed for publishers, content agencies, and educators who need to verify that submitted work is human-written. It also includes a plagiarism checker and readability score.
